t: Sent to the worst tyrant with an instruction about tone
a: فَقُولَا لَهُۥ قَوْلًا لَّيِّنًا لَّعَلَّهُۥ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوْ يَخْشَىٰ
p: Fa-qūlā lahu qawlan layyinan laʿallahu yatadhakkaru aw yakhshā.
m: And speak to him with gentle speech that perhaps he may be reminded or fear [Allāh]."
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
